description: Extracts invoice header, business (from) and client (for) contact details.
note: analyzer.json is the single mutable source of truth, tracked by git. Each promoted version is tagged in git (git tag invoiceHeader-vN) and deployed to Azure under a distinct analyzerId so multiple historical versions can be live and compared side by side. Run scripts/promote-analyzer.ps1 to tag + deploy + record a new entry here.

promotions.notes: Initial field set: InvoiceNumber, InvoiceDate, DueDate, Terms, Business*/Client* contact fields.
